title: OpenID Connect ID Token
description: Schema for validating an OpenID Connect ID Token

iss.description: Issuer - The issuer of the ID Token. REQUIRED. Issuer Identifier for the Issuer of the response. The iss value is a case-sensitive URL using the https scheme that contains scheme, host, and optionally, port number and path components and no query or fragment components.

sub.description: Subject - The subject of the token, typically a user ID.

aud.description: Audience - The intended recipient(s) of the ID Token.

exp.description: Expiration Time - The time after which the token is no longer valid.

nbf.description: Not Before - The time before which the token is not valid.

iat.description: Issued At - The time at which the token was issued.

auth_time.description: Authentication Time - The time at which the user was authenticated.

acr.description: Authentication Context Class Reference - A reference to an authentication context.

amr.description: Authentication Methods References - The authentication methods used.

azp.description: Authorized Party - The client_id of the Relying Party that the ID Token was issued to.

nonce.description: Nonce - A value that is expected to be used only once.

at_hash.description: Access Token Hash - A hash of the access token issued.

c_hash.description: Code Hash - A hash of the authorization code issued.

claims.description: Additional claims - Additional information about the authenticated user.
